race.comment: DAME OF DUBAI (7) has done plenty right in two starts and deserves top billing after winning her maiden at this track and distance on soft ground, having also been placed on debut at Hamilton after striking some trouble. This looks a nice option for her and she'll take catching for Meech again. M'LADY ROSE (9) resumed with a solid second at Ballarat on heavy ground and will be fitter from an ideal gate to stalk the main dangers. JENNI POPPINS (11) was beaten only a neck in a BM56 at Mornington. Gets weight relief and Damian Lane is aboard third up. Worth consideration. ALBANIAN I AM (2) won well here last start and is in the mix.
